description: The file defines a ViewModel class (TaskViewModel) used for managing task data and category data in a to-do list application, with functions for data retrieval, filtering, adding, updating, deleting, and toggling task completion status. It interacts with a repository class and leverages coroutines for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: TaskViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing task and category data for a to-do list application, providing methods to load, filter, add, update, delete, and toggle completion status of tasks, using a repository and Kotlin coroutines.

methods.name: refreshAll
methods.description: Loads categories and tasks, then applies current filters.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Sets the search query string and re-applies filters asynchronously.

methods.name: setSelectedCategoryName
methods.description: Sets the selected category for filtering and re-applies filters.

methods.name: ensureDefaultCategory
methods.description: Ensures default categories ('Personal' and 'Work') exist; loads categories and applies filters.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a new task via repository, reloads tasks and filters, and calls onInserted callback with new task id.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates an existing task and reloads tasks and filters.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a task and reloads tasks and filters.

methods.name: toggleComplete
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task.

methods.name: loadTasks
methods.description: Loads all tasks from the repository asynchronously.

methods.name: loadCategories
methods.description: Loads all categories from the repository asynchronously.

methods.name: applyFilters
methods.description: Filters tasks based on current query and selected category.
